definitions.gloss: to lock up; to confine; to shut in
definitions.explanation: To confine someone or something in an enclosed space by closing or locking doors, gates, or other barriers. Also used figuratively for trapping feelings, memories, or abstract things.

examples.english: I shut the dog in the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じ{込|こ}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She is keeping her sadness locked away deep in her heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じ{込|こ}められ、{二日間|ふつかかん}⟦{動|うご}けなかった→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: We were trapped at the airport by the typhoon and couldn't move for two days.

notes:
An ichidan (る) verb. The passive form {閉|と}じ{込|こ}められる is very common, describing being trapped or confined against one's will.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じ{込|こ}める (to shut ~ in ~)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じ{込|こ}められる (to be trapped/confined in ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じ{込|こ}める (to lock in a room)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じ{込|こ}める (to lock away in one's heart)
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{閉|と}じ{込|こ}められる (to be snowed in)

RELATED WORDS:
The intransitive counterpart is ⟦{閉|と}じこもる→閉じこもる：14523_tojikomoru⟧ (to shut oneself in; to become a recluse).
